The KTM 790 Adventure is a rugged, versatile, and high-performance bike designed to tackle all kinds of terrain, from challenging off-road trails to long-distance touring. With 21,000 kilometers on the clock, this bike has proven itself as a reliable companion for adventure riders, offering a thrilling and confident riding experience wherever the road (or lack thereof) takes you.

Powered by a 799cc parallel-twin engine, the 790 Adventure delivers impressive power and torque, making it perfect for both spirited road riding and tackling the toughest off-road challenges. The bike's lightweight frame and advanced suspension provide exceptional handling, whether you're navigating twisty mountain roads or navigating through dirt tracks and rocky paths.

Equipped with features such as switchable ABS, traction control, and multiple riding modes, the KTM 790 Adventure is built for adaptability and control in a wide range of conditions. The comfortable seat, ample fuel range, and durable components make it an ideal choice for those who enjoy long-distance adventures and exploring the outdoors.

If you're seeking an adventure bike that balances on-road comfort with off-road capability, the KTM 790 Adventure with 21,000 kilometers is a great option, ready to continue taking on the next great journey.

Triumph TF 450 RC edition is here and ready to blow your mind.

Triumph Motorcycles reveals its first 450cc motocross bike, designed in collaboration with the GOAT, Ricky Carmichael. The All-New Triumph TF 450-RC Edition celebrates Ricky Carmichaels involvement throughout Triumphs motocross programme, and features Ricky Carmichael's chosen specification and signature graphics. Developed by world-leading Triumph engineers and Motocross Champions, the TF 450-RC Edition features the strongest power to weight ratio in its class. Triumph's new 450cc competition motocross powertrain is compact, mass-optimised and built to take the holeshot. Engineering, design and equipment working in harmony for class leading power, control, and flexibility. The colour design prominently incorporates Triumphs Performance Yellow with black and white accents. It also includes RCs iconic number 4, GOAT logo and key sponsor details, adding a personalised flair that reflects the spirit of this motocross legend. This design is carried across number boards, swingarm decals, and other visual elements, reinforcing the bike's unique identity.
